selectionRationale: The native login was still using the retired thorn-ring artwork while web already shared the approved Green B asset. Profile saves issue a versioned avatar URL but Suggested Login discarded the version and retained stale local card metadata; a local account-scoped cache mirror plus one pre-auth public Storage image refresh fixes the display without introducing another RLS-readable profile service, SDK, or migration.
alternativeApproaches: Expose a public anonymous profiles lookup for all saved user IDs (rejected: unnecessary private profile access and account enumeration risk)
Invalidate all image caches or globally poll every avatar (rejected: extra network load, weak-signal regression, and cross-feature effects)
Overwrite the old native logo asset globally (rejected: impacts unrelated splash and configured native assets)
Delete Suggested Login cache or reset remembered logins (rejected: breaks one-tap account switching and saved device preferences)
